title: Compare Church equality definitions
description: This program evaluates two Church-boolean definitions of equality over all boolean pairs.

steps.description: TRUE and FALSE select their first or second argument. NOT, AND, and OR compose those selections.
EQ1 builds equality from AND, OR, and NOT. EQ2 directly lets p select q or NOT q.
show converts a Church boolean to 1 or 0, and the header labels the comparison columns.

steps.question: For which input pairs should equality select 1?
steps.answer: Equality selects 1 when both inputs match: both FALSE or both TRUE.

steps.description: The nested loops test every ordered pair of FALSE and TRUE, then print both equality definitions.
